mapper.select: SELECT MATERIAL_CODE CLOTH_CODE, /*帘带编号*/ IFNULL(LAYERS, 1) LAYERS, SUM(IFNULL(S.STOCK_NUM, 0) - IFNULL(S.BAD_NUM, 0) + IFNULL(S.MODIFY_NUM, 0)) STOCK_QTY FROM T_Cd90_STOCK S WHERE S.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND S.STOCK_DATE = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) /*库存要取排产日上一天的*/ GROUP BY MATERIAL_CODE, IFNULL(LAYERS, 1)
select param_code, param_value from T_XWYY_PARAMS where DEL_FLAG = '0'
select id, material_code, machine_code, IFNULL(TRUNCATE(stock_num, 0), 0) stock_num from T_CD90_LINE_SIDE_STOCK where DEL_FLAG = '0' and stock_date = DATE_SUB(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
select id, machine_code from t_cd90_machine_info where del_flag = '0'
select param_code, param_value from T_CD90_PARAMS where DEL_FLAG = '0'

SELECT CLOTH_CODE, IFNULL(SUM(night_plan_qty), 0) consume, IFNULL(Layers, 1) Layers FROM T_CD90_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_ADD(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL -1 DAY) AND DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY CLOTH_CODE, IFNULL(Layers, 1)
